The '''Sombure sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], neighboring the [[Irnaj sector/Legends|Irnaj]], [[Iska sector/Legends|Iska]], [[Oriolan sector/Legends|Oriolan]], [[Wornal sector/Legends|Wornal]] and [[Yushan sector/Legends|Yushan sectors]].

==History==
Sombure sector was controlled by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Utoxx Prentioch]]. After the substantial defeat of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Prentioch seized control of the sector's military forces and began forming his [[Prentioch's Dominion|own empire]].
